title: The 10 Best Locking Pliers Sets
subtitle: Vise-grip style locking pliers and sets, curved, straight and long nose, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: Locking pliers clamp down and stay put, so they hold work for welding, grip stripped bolts and act as a third hand. We ranked 10 best-sellers from IRWIN, Crescent, Klein Tools, SK, Amazon Basics and value brands on rating, review volume and features (4 or more pieces, a long-nose plier, a wire cutter and cushioned grips).
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: SHALL 6-Piece Locking Pliers Set, 5, 7 and 10-Inch Curved Jaw, Long Nose, 6-Inch C-Clamp
avoid.flag: Placeholder model number; specs don't match the set
avoid.verdict: A six-piece set whose listing uses a French placeholder for its model number and lists specs that can't fit the tools.
reasons: The model number field reads 'Numéro du modèle', French for 'model number', so there's no way to identify the exact product.
The spec table lists the set as 5.91 inches long, though it includes 10-inch curved jaw pliers and a 9-1/2-inch long nose.
It lists 'Inside; Amateur' as its use and 'DIN ISO 5743' as its standard, which covers pliers and nippers in general. The Evertools set has the same six pieces with a clear model number.

buyers_guide.a: They clamp onto a part and stay locked, freeing your hands. Use them to hold work for welding, grip rounded or stripped bolts, clamp parts while glue sets, or act as a temporary handle.
Curved jaws grip round stock and nuts. Straight jaws hold flat material. Long-nose jaws reach into tight spots. A C-clamp version holds pieces together for welding or gluing.

buyers_guide.q: Why does the original Vise-Grip still sell?
buyers_guide.a: IRWIN's trigger release and hardened teeth set the standard. Cheaper sets work fine for occasional use, but jaws and springs on budget sets can loosen sooner.
A trigger release gives more release force on tight clamps. Klein's lever-less design avoids pinching your palm.
A cutter in the curved jaw handles soft wire in a pinch. It's handy, not a replacement for dedicated cutters.
